data: How many different tasks are represented in the graph?

The caption states that the figure is a sensitivity analysis of the maximum length of input sequence. The question asks how many different tasks are represented in the graph. From the figure, there are four subfigures labeled (a), (b), (c), and (d). Each subfigure represents a different task: Link perdition, Similarity search, Node classification, and Node clustering. Therefore, there are four different tasks represented in the graph.
